Clara (AE): EdgeWorks committed to a short POC. Scope: streaming SDK -> tool calls for moderation -> structured JSON envelope for reranker. They sit behind a strict corporate proxy. Demo requested next Wed 10am PT. Need SE + eng + security + finance notes.

Ravi (SE): I’ll own the runbook. Q: hosted with SOC2 attestation OK for trial, or do they need Dedicated for SAML/KMS? Also what's their desired tail latency?

Noah (Eng): Tech notes: some docs ~20k tokens, target tail ~300ms. Their proxy drops SSE ~55s. Recommend websocket fallback + 12s heartbeat and chunked upload for big docs. Use ephemeral creds for the demo.

Sophie (Security): From intake: they prefer customer KMS + SAML in prod. Hosted demo OK if they accept our SOC2 attestation. Action: ask for SAML metadata XML, KMS key policy snippet, and whether they want audit logs to their SIEM.

Ben (Finance): Trial pricing suggestion: $6k credit for a 10-14 day POC with reserved capacity (1x A10G-equivalent). Function/tool call pricing = $0.002 per call + per-token inference fees. We'll include a worked example in the deck.

Ravi (SE): Noah, can you paste a minimal handshake (prefer SSE, fallback), a tiny node ws fallback, and a short structured-output example we can hand to their infra?

Noah (Eng): Handshake (curl, prefer SSE, fallback):
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/start \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPHEM>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-4b","max_tokens":20000,"interactive":true,"prefer":"sse;fallback=websocket","chunked_upload":true}'

Node ws fallback (minimal):
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/ws',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer <EPHEM>'}});
ws.on('open',()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-stream-4b',max_tokens:20000})));
setInterval(()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'heartbeat'})),12000);

Noah (Eng): Example streamed tool call event (assistant -> moderation):
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"content_moderation","args":{"text":"..."},"trace_id":"ew-01"}

Noah (Eng): Structured output sample (final response):
{"choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"score\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}","value":{"action":"allow","score":0.02}}}]}

Ravi (SE): Client guidance: window=6 concurrent in-flight chunks, heartbeat=12s, reconnect with exponential backoff + full jitter. Server recs: enable prefix KV cache for repeated segments and auto-batch target=24.

Sophie (Security): I'll request SAML metadata + KMS policy from EdgeWorks and confirm SOC2 attestation delivery. Also ask if they want audit-log forwarding to their SIEM (we support HTTP/syslog on Dedicated).

demo-bot: ephemeral token issued (valid 02:00:00) — token id: tok-edge-demo-2167 (demo only)

Clara (AE): Demo Wed 10am PT. Ravi, Noah, Sophie attending. EdgeWorks wants us to push a 10k doc and trigger moderation + structured output. Please confirm readiness by Tue EOD.

Ravi (SE): Confirmed. I'll prepare a 1-page runbook (ephemeral creds flow, handshake + ws fallback, chunked upload steps, structured envelope, proxy tips, escalation contacts) and send to their infra.

Noah (Eng): I'll produce a tiny docker image with ws fallback + chunked uploader and a short load script to exercise a 10k doc. Will post image link and run instructions by Tue.

Sophie (Security): I'll email their security lead and ask for SAML metadata XML + KMS policy snippet.

Clara (AE): Thanks team — high priority. If proxy or token-rate issues show up during smoke, ping me and we'll escalate to eng-sre. :thumbsup:
